mapper.select: SELECT id, name, channel_codes AS channelCodes, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM dahua_door_channel_group ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dahua_door_channel_group (name, channel_codes) VALUES (#{name}, #{channelCodes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel_codes = VALUES(channel_codes)
